blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Political Finance and Affairs Division (PFAD) of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) found “inconsistencies” between Sen. Rodante Marcoleta’s statements during his TV interview, where he admitted to receiving campaign donations from “friends,” and the verified position paper he submitted to the poll body. During Marcoleta’s trial before the Sandiganbayan Fourth Division on Wednesday on his alleged violation of Presidential Decree No. 46, lawyer Victoria Besinio from the Comelec PFAD testified before the court as one of the prosecution’s witnesses. The defense noted during the proceedings that Besinio cited certain inconsistencies between Macoleta’s TV remarks and his verified […]...
